title: Federation policy
description: What may be done with each data class under a federation relationship: six actions per class, and the recovery objectives of the class. The class list is open; the classification schema of a later contract pins the names. A class the policy does not list has no rule, and no rule is a denial. Validated by validatePolicy in src/engine/federation/policy.mjs; docs/FEDERATION.md describes it.

version.description: The version a relationship names as accepted.

rpo_seconds.description: Recovery point objective of the class, in seconds.

rto_seconds.description: Recovery time objective of the class, in seconds.
